user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop lifting box that uses a hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform by 80-100 mm, supporting 1 kg, with enclosed mechanism, safe operation, and practical manufacturing.
product_intent: A compact desktop device with an external hand crank for manual operation that raises and lowers an internal platform vertically by 80-100 mm to support a payload of approximately 1 kg, with the lifting mechanism enclosed within the housing.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop lifting box
The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform
The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm
The platform should support a payload of approximately 1 kg
The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing
The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture
Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation
Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable
Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed

requirements.statement: The product must allow a user to rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform

verification.observable: platform movement when hand crank is rotated

requirements.statement: The internal platform must lift approximately 80-100 mm
The internal platform must support a payload of approximately 1 kg
The lifting mechanism must be enclosed inside the housing
The product must be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture
The product must avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation
The product must operate manually only

freedoms.subject: lifting operation frequency (continuous or intermittent)
freedoms.statement: Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable

freedoms.subject: mechanical components
freedoms.statement: Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed

relations.rationale: Platform lifting distance depends on the hand crank operation
Payload support depends on the hand crank operation and platform design

operating_scenarios.name: Normal operation with manual hand crank
operating_scenarios.description: A user rotates the external hand crank to raise or lower the internal platform within its specified range while supporting a payload of 1 kg.

operating_scenarios.name: Safe operation environment
operating_scenarios.description: The product operates in a desktop environment where it must be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
